name: B10-0077/2026 (PfE) – Brutal repression against protesters in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Iran's violent crackdown on protesters who took to the streets in December 2025 over inflation and food prices. It calls for an immediate end to live ammunition against civilians, the release of people held for peaceful protest, and accountability for killings. It also asks the European Union to sanction Iranian officials and security bodies responsible, and to list Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation.

- The EU is asked to sanction Iranian officials and security bodies behind the crackdown.
- It affects Iranian leaders, security forces, and EU relations with Iran.
- Next: EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these calls.
